subject: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@riberahealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@riberahealth.com
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints

Hi Ben —

We're kicking off the procurement checklist on our side and have a few non-negotiable items from ERP/finance:

- We need the Luma PO/PO line reference (our PO number) reflected in the invoice header so our ERP (Coupa/Workday) auto-matches.
- Prefer EDI 810 invoices pushed to our SFTP in addition to a human-readable PDF (our EDI team requires the 810 format for automated posting).
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices are preferred (single invoice per month per PO).
- Net terms: Ribera standard is Net60, but we can discuss.
- Pricing: procurement will need a written discount floor for any committed spend tiers — we cannot approve anything that leaves variability without a floor.

Can your billing team confirm whether Redwood supports EDI 810, whether PO number can be in the main invoice header (not just line items), and an expected timeline for EDI onboarding? Also, please include a pricing attachment that maps commit -> discount so procurement can run legal/finance review.

Attached: our PO template (PO_4487.xlsx) for reference.

Thanks,
Avery Collins
Senior Procurement Manager, Ribera Health
avery.collins@riberahealth.com

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@riberahealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-09T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the clear list — appreciate the ERP specifics. Short answers up front: yes we can include the PO number in the invoice header and we can support EDI 810, but EDI setup is a separate technical onboarding that usually takes 4–6 weeks. For near-term you can accept a monthly consolidated PDF invoice with the PO referenced in the invoice header while we stand up the EDI feed.

On pricing/packaging: two practical options to consider (so procurement has something concrete to evaluate):

1) Annual committed arrangement — $300k annual commit, invoiced monthly, 18% discount applied to usage up to the committed amount; additional usage billed at standard list. EDI setup included; requires an annual PO/commit.

2) Usage-first with invoice cadence guarantee — pay-as-you-go with a 12% discount floor for the first 6 months if you sign a 6-month PO for minimum projected spend; EDI setup treated as add-on.

If Net60 is a hard requirement, we can accommodate but the effective discount levels shift slightly (we typically need Net45 for the higher discounts unless there is a prepay or committed term). I’ve CC’d Vanessa to confirm the EDI timeline and the Redwood billing team's standard mapping layout so you can validate ERP match fields. Vivek is CC'd for finance/credit visibility.

Next steps I suggest: Vanessa confirms technical EDI fields and SFTP details; I’ll put together a short pricing attachment that maps commit tiers to discount floors so you can circulate to procurement/legal. If that sounds right, I’ll get a draft amendment template for invoicing cadence to legal.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@riberahealth.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints

Hi Avery —

Quick billing note from our side:

- PO number in header: yes — we can populate the PO number in the invoice header (Invoice.ReferenceID) which should cover your ERP auto-match requirement.
- EDI 810: we support standard 810 formatting and can do an SFTP push to your endpoint. Typical EDI onboarding timeline is 4–6 weeks (mapping, test cycles, cert).
- Interim flow: we will send a consolidated monthly PDF invoice with a CSV stub that includes PO, PO line, account code, and internal charge class so your AP team can import immediately while EDI is being stood up.
- Net terms and credit: finance has to sign off on Net60 for committed deals. Vivek — can you confirm the credit cadence if we accept Net60 for $300k commit?

Attached: Redwood_PRICING_TIERS.csv (mapping of commit bands -> discount) and a short PO_GUIDE_EDI810.pdf describing field names we populate.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@riberahealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@riberahealth.com
Date: 2027-05-10T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints

Ben/Vanessa —

Appreciate the options and the quick turnaround. Procurement is comfortable with the interim consolidated monthly PDF + CSV stub while EDI is enabled. A couple of asks before I route to legal/finance:

- Discount floor: Ribera needs a written discount floor in the SOW/amendment that guarantees no less than 20% for a $300k committed annual spend (we'll circulate our standard discount approval form).
- Net terms: we will push for Net60 as standard; if Redwood needs Net45 we need the higher discount reflected.
- Amendment: please prepare an amendment that explicitly calls out invoice cadence (monthly consolidated), the EDI onboarding timeline (targeted completion date), and a fallback process for the first 2 months.

Attaching our procurement PO template (PO_4487.xlsx) — please confirm it will be accepted if we include the annual PO referencing the deal id DW-9372.

If you can confirm the 20% floor in writing (or provide a counter numeric), I’ll put things through legal for redline.

Thanks,
Avery

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@riberahealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EDI 850 PO mapping, invoice cadence & procurement constraints

Avery —

Thanks. We can make a firm written offer to match most of this and get legal started. Commercial counter-proposal:

- Commit & discount: 18% discount on a $300k annual committed PO (12 monthly invoices) if Net45. If Redwood accepts Net60, the discount floor we can offer is 15% (Net60 increases credit exposure).
- Invoice cadence: agree to monthly consolidated PDF + CSV stub during onboarding; EDI 810 SFTP push to be completed within 6 weeks of PO activation. We will add an amendment clause with a defined target date and test acceptance criteria.
- PO acceptance: PO_4487 format is acceptable as long as the PO number is present in the header and the PO references DW-9372 in the reference field.

If those terms are acceptable, I’ll ask Legal to draft an amendment reflecting the invoice cadence, EDI onboarding timeline, and the discount floor tied to payment terms. Vivek, please flag if finance requires additional credit hold or prepay for Net60 at that commit level.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
